text:
elaine.sales: Heads-up 1 AstraMed RFP inbound. They want a capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and a two-track POC plan. Unique asks: FIPS-certified HSM, WORM audit log retention, and a "red-team sandbox" for model safety testing. POC window = 3 weeks. PDF attached in thread.

raj-se: Copy. Any performance numbers? If they want red-team sandbox we should also note isolation requirements.

elaine.sales: They specify ~350 concurrent connections during business hours, avg prompt 100 tokens, avg response 300 tokens. Latency targets: p50 <= 220ms, p95 <= 500ms. They also want per-token cost reporting during POC.

raj-se: For those numbers I'd recommend baseline = 3x A100-equivalent GPUs for dedicated, autoscale to 5 for spikes. Air-gapped appliance will probably need bigger machines to hit p95. Will draft matrix and call out risk for air-gapped.

frank-ops: Deployment clarification: they asked for both private VPC deployment and a sealed appliance image for air-gapped installs. Because they require WORM logs and FIPS-only crypto, note that appliance build will need security signoff (~12 business days).

svc-bot: Compliance snapshot: SOC2-TypeII = yes, ISO27001 = partial, FedRAMP = no, FIPS-140 = available for partner HSM, KMS-integration = supported, WORM-logs = supported via S3-object-lock or onsite WORM appliance. See /sales/rfps/templates/worm-and-hsm.md.

marta-csm: We must lock success criteria before the POC: perf pass (throughput + latency), successful HSM key rotation test, red-team sandbox isolation verified, and audit log export validated. I'll ask AstraMed for a written acceptance checklist.

sara-legal: We'll need a DPA + air-gapped addendum. Add clauses for HSM custody, FIPS attestation, and WORM log retention responsibilities. Also check if they need export-control language for models used in sandbox. I'll draft redline.

frank-ops: For teardown: include a signed data-zeroize attestation and a forensic snapshot workflow. Air-gap install notes should include USB manifest signing (SHA256), manual key injection steps, and instructions for enabling WORM mode on local storage.

raj-se: Quick CSV snippet for the capability matrix (to include):
```
capability,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,air-gapped
concurrent-connections,1200,4000,350,350
p50-latency,110ms,95ms,210ms,260ms
p95-latency,430ms,320ms,480ms,720ms
kms-mode,managed,customer-managed,connector,hsm-offline
hsm-mode,n/a,optional,optional,fips-certified
worm-logs,optional,optional,optional,onsite-enabled
per-token-reporting,yes,yes,yes,limited-offline
```

elaine.sales: Good start. Raj, expand into the RFP matrix and include a short POC runbook for both tracks (install, smoke tests, perf script, red-team sandbox steps). Frank, draft teardown + zeroization attestation and USB manifest template. Sara, please prepare DPA redline. I'll schedule kickoff with their infra lead for Mon 14:00 UTC.

raj-se: Will do. ETA for matrix + runbook draft: tomorrow EOD. Note: if AstraMed insists on p95 <= 400ms in air-gapped mode we should propose a heavier spec or agree on a relaxed goal.

frank-ops: Flag: FIPS-only appliance build + WORM enablement adds ~12 business days and may push beyond their 3-week POC window. Also offline telemetry collection will be limited; include manual export steps.

marta-csm: I'll request explicit written acceptance criteria from AstraMed before the kickoff. Also ask if they want a scripted per-token billing export or manual CSV.

sara-legal: Uploading initial DPA redline to the shared doc and will add HSM/zeroization clause.

svc-bot: Reminder: attach AstraMed_RFP_v1.pdf and AstraMed_SecQ_v2.pdf. Use /sales/rfps/templates/billing-hook.csv for per-token reporting during POC.

elaine.sales: Thanks team. I uploaded attachments and sent the invite. Please review and flag blockers before the kickoff. :thumbsup:
